symptom: The active tab, pressed toggles and chosen chips read as outlined: segmented tabs drew an inset ring, Secondary and Ghost buttons, IconButton and Pill pressed to border4 or border2, and the user had to find each one.
rule: Selection is a fill, never an edge: pressed, active and chosen controls fill with selected-bg and keep their resting edge, owned by the primitives; ui/selection-edge fails on any edge drawn on a selected state (docs/design-system.md §0 item 8).
